text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before running in the Champions Cup. 
Unlike last year, Hokko Tarumae was 
remarkably calm and composed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Because my hometown is supporting me—" As 
she said those words, she realized 
something. Her Trainer had also been 
supporting her all along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Waiting to take her on was the seasoned 
veteran Wonder Acute. And true to her 
promise, the up-and-coming Feng Shui 
Umamusume, Copano Rickey, had arrived as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this long-awaited race finally 
realized, Hokko Tarumae declares to her 
rivals that the one who will shine the 
brightest today will be her—!
